name: Ebonroc
notes: Numbers follow docs/research/blackwing-lair/ebonroc.md. Era 40-man: 999,300 HP, no enrage, tauntable. Modelled as one 270 s phase (research: 4-5 minutes). Shadow of Ebonroc: 8 s debuff on the tank, first ~45 s, then every 25-35 s (cmangos); each melee hit on the debuffed tank heals him for 25,000 (classicdb, Warcraft Tavern, Millenium). ENGINE GAP: boss HP is a phase clock, so a landed hit cannot heal him; the 25k heal cannot be modelled and only the swap itself can be scored. Modelled as a tank `debuff` (8 s, no damage) plus a `targetSwitch` onto the raid so the swap can be scored: in the real fight he stays on the debuffed tank until Taunted off, and the failure is 25,000 healed per hit, not a loose boss (Wowhead). The tank (the next tank in the queue in this rehearsal) must Taunt him off within 2 s or he keeps eating 25k heals (tips, cues). The ghost tank Taunts back after 3 s in the non-tank roles. The real anti-stacking rule ("never Taunt twice in a row by the same tank", Wowhead anecdote) is an open question and not modelled. Wing Buffet: `knockback` with `threatCut: 0.5` (Warcraft Wiki 50%), first ~30 s then every 30-35 s (cmangos, logs 31.1-36 s), 1 s cast, with wall behind the tank blocking the throw. The real plan is a buffet tank at 3 or 9 o'clock Taunting right before it, which the single-tank-role engine cannot express: the tank eats it and Taunts back. The Taunt cooldown is 5 s (real Taunt is 10 s) because the real raid has two or three tanks sharing the Taunting and a single Taunt cannot cover Shadow of Ebonroc and Wing Buffet landing a few seconds apart. Shadow Flame: 2 s cast, 45 yd cone, first ~18 s then every 15-18 s (cmangos; logs 12.9-23.4 s; open question), 4000 Shadow (real 3938-5063), `conditional: onPlayer`. The no-cloak DoT is not modelled (Onyxia Scale Cloak assumed). Thrash: cone on the tank every ~4 s. Summon Player is not modelled. Damage is scaled so a 10,000 HP tank survives normal play but dies if the healer ignores a spike: melee 600 per 2 s, Thrash 500, Shadow Flame 4000, Wing Buffet 750; placeholders. Passive healing is 950 HP/s on a player tank and on the ghost without a healer, 200 with a healer player. Shadow of Ebonroc itself deals no damage. Engine gaps: boss cannot be healed by a landed hit (HP is a clock), so the 25,000-per-hit punishment is words only; one tank role, so the real three-tank layout (12/3/9 o'clock) and rotation becomes a single player re-Taunting; no Mortal Strike debuff on him.

tankSpot.label: Tank: back to the wall, 12 o'clock

healerSpot.label: Healers: in reach of the tank

tank.label: Main tank
tank.description: Hold him at the stair wall with his head on the wall. When Shadow of Ebonroc lands on the current tank, the next tank in the queue Taunts at once, or every hit heals him for 25,000. In this rehearsal you are that next tank, every time.

melee.label: Melee DPS
melee.description: Stand directly behind Ebonroc, away from the tanks. Wing Buffet halves the tank's threat, so stop attacking if the threat bar turns red. Attack again once the tank has a safe lead; Ebonroc's self-heal makes damage uptime important.

ranged.label: Ranged DPS
ranged.description: Stand directly behind him at range, with the melee. Keep attacking: the faster he dies the fewer heals he gets. Stop only in the red band.

healer.label: Healer
healer.description: Stay in reach of whoever has him. Shadow Flame lands on the current tank every 15 to 18 seconds. Nothing here can be dispelled.

taunt.label: Taunt
taunt.tip: Ebonroc can be Taunted, and the cooldown here is 5 s because in the real raid two or three tanks share the Taunting. Press it the moment Shadow of Ebonroc lands, to take him off the debuffed tank, and straight after a Wing Buffet. Never while he is already on you.

attack.label: Attack
attack.tip: Attacks generate threat. Stop when the threat bar turns red so the boss stays on the tank.

heal.label: Heal the tank
heal.tip: A large heal for the tank. Time it to land with the incoming damage.

shadowOfEbonroc.label: Shadow of Ebonroc
shadowOfEbonroc.tip: An 8 second debuff on the tank. While it is up every swing that lands on them heals Ebonroc for 25,000. Someone else must Taunt him off immediately.

shadowTurn.label: Shadow of Ebonroc: swap
shadowTurn.toast: Shadow of Ebonroc! Next tank, Taunt now. Every hit on that tank would heal him 25,000.
shadowTurn.tip: He has to come off the debuffed tank.

shadowFlame.label: Shadow Flame
shadowFlame.tip: A 2 s cast, 4 to 5 thousand Shadow in a 45 yd cone. Everybody but the tank is behind him, with their Onyxia Scale Cloak on.

wingBuffet.label: Wing Buffet
wingBuffet.tip: A frontal shove and half your threat, every 30 to 35 seconds. Back to the wall and Taunt the moment he turns.

thrash.label: Thrash
thrash.tip: Three swings in quick succession on the tank. Spike healing, and on a debuffed tank each one is another 25,000 heal for him.

phases.name: Ebonroc
phases.subtitle: Taunt off every Shadow of Ebonroc

expectations.label: Pull him to the stair wall
expectations.tip: Taunt him, walk to the wall and turn him so his head is on it. Melee and ranged go behind him.

expectations.label: Taunt him off the debuffed tank
expectations.tip: Shadow of Ebonroc means every hit on that tank heals him for 25,000. Taunt him off the debuffed tank instantly, every time.

expectations.label: Taunt straight after the buffet
expectations.tip: Wing Buffet halves your threat and he turns. Taunt the moment you see it.

expectations.label: Keep your back to the wall
expectations.tip: If there is open floor behind you, Wing Buffet throws you. Corner him and stay there.

expectations.label: His head stays on the wall
expectations.tip: Shadow Flame goes 45 yards in front of him. If it reaches the raid, people die.

expectations.label: Never pull aggro off the tank
expectations.tip: Stop attacking while the threat bar is red. Resume when it leaves the red band.

expectations.label: Stop in the red band after a Wing Buffet
expectations.tip: The tank has just lost half their threat. If you were close before, you are over them now.

expectations.label: Stay out of Shadow Flame
expectations.tip: Everybody but the tank stands behind him. Nowhere in front is safe.

expectations.label: Keep the tank alive
expectations.tip: Shadow Flame every 16 s and Thrash bursts in between. Pre-shield the tank before the breath and heal right after.

threatLostCount.label: Times he turned on the raid

aggroPulls.label: Times you pulled aggro
aggroPulls.tip: Stop attacking when the threat bar turns red.

attacksInRed.label: Attacks in the red band
attacksInRed.tip: Stop attacking in the red band so the tank can regain a threat lead.

earlyAttacks.label: Attacks before the tank had him
earlyAttacks.tip: Give the tank a few seconds after the pull.

earlyPulls.label: You pulled him before the tank

dpsIdle.label: Seconds not attacking when you could
dpsIdle.tip: Keep attacking when it's safe. Stop if the threat bar turns red or the boss leaves the tank.

playerInHazard.label: Seconds standing in fire
playerInHazard.tip: Move out of the fire before attacking again.

tankLowSeconds.label: Seconds with the tank under half
tankLowSeconds.tip: Top the tank up before the spike lands, not after.

overheals.label: Wasted heals
overheals.tip: Avoid healing the tank at full health. Save the heal for incoming damage.

playerInFront.label: Standing in his front
playerInFront.tip: Melee stand directly behind him and never in front.

buffetsOffWall.label: Buffets taken off the wall
buffetsOffWall.tip: Back to the wall. In the open Wing Buffet throws you and he moves.

cues.notes: Press notes: Taunt him off the debuffed tank and straight after a Wing Buffet; Heal behind each Shadow Flame.

list.label: Taunt when he turns
list.tip: Shadow of Ebonroc on the tank, or a Wing Buffet has dropped your threat. Taunt him now, every hit on a debuffed tank heals him 25,000.

list.label: Heal right after Shadow Flame
list.tip: Land the big heal the moment the breath lands.

list.label: Heal the tank when they drop low
list.tip: Under half with a Shadow Flame coming is where tanks die. Heal now.

drills.name: Shadow of Ebonroc swaps
drills.description: Already against the wall. Shadow of Ebonroc every 13 s: Taunt him off the debuffed tank the moment it lands, and Taunt straight after a Wing Buffet.

drills.name: Behind him, keep attacking
drills.description: Attack on every global but stop in the red band. Every Wing Buffet halves the tank.

drills.name: Shadow Flame healing
drills.description: Heal right behind each Shadow Flame while Thrash spikes the tank between them.
